key.name: profiles
key.summary: Saved profiles
key.description: JSON array of profiles. Each profile stores a wallpaper and optional appearance settings; null fields are left unchanged when the profile is applied.

key.name: active-profile
key.summary: ID of the profile that was applied last

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the “Original” profile has been created

key.name: migrated-from-bg-changer
key.summary: Whether data of the BG Changer extension has been taken over

key.name: transition
key.summary: Wallpaper transition
key.description: “circle” reveals the new wallpaper with a growing circle, “fade” keeps GNOME's own crossfade.

key.name: transition-duration
key.summary: Duration of the circle transition in milliseconds

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the button in the top bar

key.name: atelier-open-switcher
key.summary: Open the profile switcher

key.name: atelier-open-wallpapers
key.summary: Open the switcher on the Wallpapers tab

key.name: wallpaper-folder
key.summary: Folder shown on the Wallpapers tab
key.description: Empty means ~/Pictures/Wallpapers, which is created when needed.

key.name: atelier-next-profile
key.summary: Apply the next profile

key.name: atelier-previous-profile
key.summary: Apply the previous profile

key.name: gtk4-link
key.summary: GTK 4 links made by BG Changer
key.description: JSON object listing the symlinks in ~/.config/gtk-4.0 that BG Changer created. Atelier replaces them with a generated stylesheet and then clears this key.

key.name: gtk4-theme
key.summary: Theme imported for GTK 4 apps
key.description: Directory of the GTK theme whose GTK 4 stylesheet is imported into ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css, or empty. Set when a profile with GTK 4 theming is applied.

key.name: gtk-css-problem
key.summary: Why the GTK stylesheets could not be written, if they couldn't

key.name: apply-request
key.summary: Request from the preferences to apply a profile
key.description: JSON object with the profile ID and a nonce. Written by the preferences window, handled by the shell.

key.name: source
key.summary: Where the palette comes from
key.description: “wallpaper” picks the most fitting color of the wallpaper, “swatch” uses the chosen swatch of the wallpaper, “preset” uses a fixed palette.

key.name: swatch
key.summary: Swatch of the wallpaper used when the source is “swatch”

key.name: preset
key.summary: Fixed palette used when the source is “preset”

key.name: variant
key.summary: How colorful the palette is

key.name: gtk-apps
key.summary: Color GTK apps with the palette

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Color GNOME Terminal with the palette

key.name: terminal-profile
key.summary: GNOME Terminal profile created by Atelier

key.name: terminal-previous-default
key.summary: GNOME Terminal profile that was the default before Atelier's

key.name: current
key.summary: The palette in use (JSON), written by the shell

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show the island in the middle of the top bar
key.description: The island takes the place of GNOME's clock: it shows the time, grows into a glance on hover and hosts the switcher, the power menu, notifications, profile toasts and the control centre, which opens when it is clicked.

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date next to the time

key.name: glance-on-hover
key.summary: Show the glance while the pointer rests on the island
key.description: A big clock, this week, what's left of today's events and the weather.

key.name: profile-toast
key.summary: Show the profile's name in the island when switching to it

key.name: atelier-power-menu
key.summary: Open the power menu in the island

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show notifications in the island
key.description: Banners appear in the island instead of under the top bar. GNOME still decides which notifications show (Do Not Disturb, per-app settings, the queue), and they stay in the notification list.

key.name: app-buttons
key.summary: Buttons of notifications, per app
key.description: JSON object mapping GNOME's notification app keys (e.g. "org-gnome-nautilus") to "app" (the app's own buttons, the default), "none" or "reply-mute". WhatsApp as a Chrome app gets Reply and Mute, Claude none.

key.name: muted
key.summary: Muted apps
key.description: JSON object mapping app keys to the end of the mute in Unix seconds, or 0 until it is lifted. Notifications of muted apps go to the list without a banner.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Open the control centre in the island
key.description: Clicking the island (or Super+S) opens a control centre with GNOME's quick settings – Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sliders, power mode, tiles of extensions – and, on further tabs, GNOME's notification list (Super+V) and calendar, instead of GNOME's menus. The status icons in the top bar only show the state.

key.name: extensions
key.summary: Move extension icons into the control centre
key.description: Icons that extensions put into the top bar move to the control centre's Extensions tab. The bar keeps the workspaces, the island, the status icons and the screen sharing and recording indicators.

key.name: style
key.summary: Look of the top bar
key.description: “grouped” puts the workspaces, the island and the status icons together in the middle, “spread” the workspaces at the left edge and the status icons at the right one, “island” all of them into one island. None of them has a background of its own. “gnome” keeps GNOME's black bar.

key.name: compact
key.summary: Only the essentials in the middle
key.description: Grouped and as one island, the bar shows only the workspaces, the time and the battery (and the screen recording and sharing indicators while they are on). The control centre has everything else.

key.name: sides
key.summary: Where the workspaces and the status icons lie
key.description: “wallpaper” right on the wallpaper, “capsules” in capsules like the island. (In the “island” style, they are in the island.)

key.name: surface
key.summary: What the island and the capsules are made of
key.description: “classic” is black, “glass” the blurred wallpaper.

key.name: modules
key.summary: Modules on the right of the top bar
key.description: “claude” (Claude Code's usage in this 5-hour block) and “weather”. They only show something; resting the pointer on one shows its details in the island.

key.name: island-shape
key.summary: Shape of the island
key.description: “floating” is a capsule in the bar, “notch” hangs from the top edge of the screen.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Widgets on the desktop

key.name: widgets
key.summary: The widgets and where they are
key.description: JSON array of {id, kind, size, x, y}: kind is clock, date, calendar, weather, github, claude or photo; size square, card, large or wide; x and y are cells of the grid over the work area of the primary monitor.

key.name: style
key.summary: Look of the widgets
key.description: “modern” is dark cards in the palette's colors, “analogue” light paper with a clock that has hands.

key.name: glass
key.summary: Modern widgets of glass
key.description: The blurred wallpaper under the Modern widgets, rather than solid cards.

key.name: card-opacity
key.summary: How much of their background the cards keep
key.description: 1 is the look as it is; less, and the wallpaper (or the glass) shows through the cards, their shadow fading with them.

key.name: github-user
key.summary: GitHub user of the GitHub widget
key.description: Its contributions come from GitHub's public page of this user; no account or token is needed.

key.name: photo
key.summary: Picture of the photo widget
key.description: A picture, or a folder whose pictures take turns every hour.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Notes
key.description: Written in the island (the control centre's Notes tab), shown on the desktop and pinned to the screen's edges.

key.name: edges-on-desktop-only
key.summary: Notes on the edges only on the desktop
key.description: Pinned notes lie under the windows instead of over them.

key.name: atelier-open-notes
key.summary: Open the notes

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Atelier's dock
key.description: Pinned apps and those with windows on the workspace, at an edge of the screen, with room for Dynamic Music Pill. It stays off while Dash to Dock is on.

key.name: intellihide
key.summary: Out of the way of windows
key.description: The dock moves away when windows cover it (which ones: intellihide-mode), and comes back when the pointer reaches its edge.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Size of the dock's icons, logical pixels
key.description: The biggest they get: smaller when the apps don't all fit in the dock's length, unless icon-size-fixed is on.

key.name: dock-position
key.summary: Edge of the screen the dock is at

key.name: preferred-monitor-by-connector
key.summary: Monitor of the dock
key.description: The connector of the monitor (as 'DP-1'), or 'primary' for the main one. A monitor that isn't plugged in means the main one.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: A dock on every monitor
key.description: The others have the same apps; Dynamic Music Pill stays in the main one.

key.name: magnification
key.summary: Magnify the icons under the pointer
key.description: As the pointer moves along the dock, the icon under it grows (those beside it less and less) and the others move apart; the dock keeps its size.

key.name: magnification-scale
key.summary: How big the icon under the pointer gets
key.description: 1.3 is a third bigger again; 2 twice as big.

key.name: magnification-spread
key.summary: How far the magnification reaches
key.description: In icons, from the pointer.

key.name: show-in-overview
key.summary: In the overview, in place of GNOME's dash
key.description: The dock stays in the overview and GNOME's dash is hidden; the overview keeps clear of it. Off, the dock goes in the overview and the dash is there as usual.

key.name: dock-fixed
key.summary: Always visible
key.description: The dock never moves away, and maximized windows end where it begins.

key.name: extend-height
key.summary: Panel mode
key.description: The dock stretches along the whole edge of the screen, touching it.

key.name: always-center-icons
key.summary: Icons in the middle in panel mode
key.description: The icons stay in the middle of the edge rather than at its start.

key.name: height-fraction
key.summary: Maximum length of the dock
key.description: As a fraction of the edge it is at.

key.name: icon-size-fixed
key.summary: Icons keep their size
key.description: When the apps don't all fit, the dock scrolls instead of making its icons smaller.

key.name: scroll-to-focused-application
key.summary: Scroll to the focused app
key.description: When the dock scrolls (icon-size-fixed), the focused app is scrolled into view.

key.name: show-favorites
key.summary: Show the pinned apps

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Show the running apps
key.description: Apps with windows that aren't pinned.

key.name: autohide
key.summary: Hide when the pointer leaves
key.description: The dock goes when the pointer leaves it, and comes back when the pointer reaches its edge.

key.name: require-pressure-to-show
key.summary: Push against the edge to show
key.description: The pointer has to push against the edge of the screen for the dock to come back.

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.summary: How hard to push
key.description: Pixels the pointer has to move against the edge.

key.name: intellihide-mode
key.summary: Which windows move the dock away
key.description: Any window, those of the focused app, maximized (or full screen) ones, or only full screen ones: otherwise the dock stays on top.

key.name: manualhide
key.summary: Hidden until called
key.description: The dock stays away until it is called (with the keyboard shortcut).

key.name: animation-time
key.summary: Time the dock takes to move, seconds

key.name: show-delay
key.summary: Time before the dock comes back, seconds

key.name: hide-delay
key.summary: Time before the dock moves away, seconds

key.name: autohide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: In fullscreen too
key.description: The dock can be brought back over a window that fills the screen.

key.name: show-dock-urgent-notify
key.summary: Show the dock for urgent windows
key.description: The dock comes back while a window asks for attention.

key.name: click-action
key.summary: What a click on an app does

key.name: shift-click-action
key.summary: What a click on an app with Shift held does

key.name: middle-click-action
key.summary: What a middle click on an app does

key.name: shift-middle-click-action
key.summary: What a middle click on an app with Shift held does

key.name: scroll-action
key.summary: What scrolling on an app does

key.name: scroll-switch-workspace
key.summary: Scrolling on the dock switches workspace

key.name: activate-single-window
key.summary: A click brings up only the latest window
key.description: Clicked, an app brings up its latest window rather than all of them.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.summary: Only windows on the current workspace
key.description: Apps count as running, and are switched through, with windows on the current workspace only.

key.name: isolate-monitors
key.summary: Only windows on the dock's monitor

key.name: workspace-agnostic-urgent-windows
key.summary: Urgent windows from every workspace
key.description: A window asking for attention counts wherever it is.

key.name: running-indicator-style
key.summary: How running apps are marked

key.name: running-indicator-dominant-color
key.summary: Marks in the app's own colour

key.name: custom-theme-customize-running-dots
key.summary: Marks in colours of their own

key.name: custom-theme-running-dots-color
key.summary: Colour of the marks

key.name: custom-theme-running-dots-border-color
key.summary: Colour of the marks' border

key.name: custom-theme-running-dots-border-width
key.summary: Width of the marks' border, pixels

key.name: show-icons-notifications-counter
key.summary: Count of notifications on the icons

key.name: application-counter-overrides-notifications
key.summary: The app's own count first
key.description: A count the app gives (over Unity's launcher API) shows instead of the notifications'.

key.name: show-icons-emblems
key.summary: Badges and progress on the icons

key.name: dance-urgent-applications
key.summary: Wiggle urgent apps
key.description: An app whose window asks for attention wiggles.

key.name: hide-tooltip
key.summary: Hide the apps' names
key.description: No name shows while the pointer rests on an app.

key.name: show-show-apps-button
key.summary: Show Applications button

key.name: show-apps-at-top
key.summary: Show Applications at the start
key.description: At the start of the dock rather than at its end.

key.name: show-apps-always-in-the-edge
key.summary: Show Applications at the edge in panel mode
key.description: In panel mode it stays at the end of the edge, away from the icons.

key.name: show-trash
key.summary: Trash in the dock

key.name: show-mounts
key.summary: Drives in the dock

key.name: show-mounts-only-mounted
key.summary: Only mounted drives

key.name: show-mounts-network
key.summary: Network drives too

key.name: isolate-locations
key.summary: File manager windows as their own icons
key.description: A file manager window showing the trash or a drive goes with its icon rather than with the file manager.

key.name: hot-keys
key.summary: Super+number opens the apps
key.description: Super with 1 to 0 opens (or switches to) the dock's apps in order, in place of GNOME's own shortcuts.

key.name: hotkeys-overlay
key.summary: Show the numbers
key.description: For a moment after Super and a number (or the shortcut), the apps show their numbers.

key.name: hotkeys-show-dock
key.summary: Show the dock with the numbers

key.summary: Shortcut to show the dock

key.name: shortcut-timeout
